description: A shopping basket (up to 25 products) compared across countries: per country and product the lowest EUR price and the median over chains, the basket totals, and a ranking of the countries that have every product. Product ids come from search_products. Costs 3 credits (0.006 USDC with x402).

country.description: Limit to these countries (ISO-2 country code in lower case (al, at, ba, be, bg, ch, cy, cz, de, dk, ee, es, fi, fr, gb, gr, hr, hu, ie, is, it, lt, lu, lv, mt, nl, pl, pt, ro, rs, se, si, sk, tr)); default all.

products.description: Registry ids, "ean:<code>" or barcodes, up to 25.

name: compare_basket
title: Compare a basket across countries
